module_title: BrahMos, ASAT, and Modern Naval/Air Assets
introduction: At this level, we explore India's most advanced and lethal defense technologies, which place the nation in the elite club of global military superpowers.

core_concepts.title: BrahMos - The Ultimate Brahmastra
core_concepts.description:
It is a joint venture between India (DRDO) and **Russia (NPO Mashinostroyeniya)**. 
Name: Derived from the 'Brahmaputra' river of India and the 'Moskva' river of Russia. 
Type: It is a **Supersonic Cruise Missile**. 
Speed: Approx. 2.8 Mach (almost 3 times the speed of sound). 
Specialty: It can be launched from land, air (Sukhoi-30 MKI), ships, or submarines. It is one of the fastest cruise missiles in the world.

core_concepts.title: Mission Shakti - ASAT
core_concepts.description: In 2019, India successfully tested an 'Anti-Satellite (ASAT)' missile. India used a missile to shoot down a live satellite in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). This achievement made India only the **fourth country** in the world (after the USA, Russia, and China) to possess this capability.

core_concepts.title: Major Air and Naval Assets
core_concepts.description:
1. **Tejas:** India's indigenous Light Combat Aircraft (LCA). 
2. **INS Arihant:** India's first indigenously built Nuclear-Powered Ballistic Missile Submarine (SSBN). 
3. **INS Vikrant:** India's first Indigenous Aircraft Carrier (IAC-1).

core_concepts.title: S-400 Triumf
core_concepts.description: Considered one of the most advanced 'Air Defense Systems' in the world, purchased by India from **Russia**. It can track and destroy incoming enemy missiles, fighter jets, and drones in the air from a distance of up to 400 km.

important_entities.name: Ramjet Engine Technology
important_entities.significance: BrahMos uses a 'Ramjet' engine. Unlike traditional rockets that carry heavy liquid oxygen tanks with them, a ramjet 'breathes' oxygen directly from the atmosphere at supersonic speeds to burn its fuel. This reduces the missile's weight and drastically increases its speed and range.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: This is the most common confusion point. Always remember that Agni is a Ballistic missile, whereas BrahMos is strictly a **Cruise** missile.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: When an object travels faster than the speed of sound (approx. 343 m/s), it is called 'Supersonic'. BrahMos travels at 2.8 Mach.

exam_strategy_tips: Frequently asked in UPSC/State PCS: 'The BrahMos missile is a joint venture between India and which other country?' Answer: Russia.
